change_summary: Restore the durable-value boundary for bounded native transformations, keep coherent descriptive handoffs autonomous, and route coding-host local-byte transfer through the deterministic official CLI when available.

canonical_skill.note: The internal shared Skill release 1.7.17 preserves source authority while separating bounded host-native no-write results from coherent durable handoffs and preferring deterministic CLI byte transfer in coding hosts.

server_contract.note: The 2026-09-09.7 wire contract remains compatible; its shared server-contract owner now states the same durable-value ordering and local-byte bridge preference without widening authority.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.17 while retaining the compatible 2026-09-09.7 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 remains compatible with the unchanged 2026-09-09.7 wire contract; this release does not change CLI bytes.

help_center.note: Existing multilingual MCP Help already covers natural delegation and canonical artifact URLs; no Help bytes change in 1.7.17.

package_setup.note: The existing bounded session hook remains compatible; OAuth endpoints, scopes, installation commands, and session-refresh ownership do not change.

harness_and_mainline.note: The host-neutral 30 by 2 denominator and vague prompts remain unchanged; the Harness records the repaired durable-value and deterministic local-byte routing boundaries.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; the two-host fresh acceptance matrix remains runtime evidence and WorkBuddy is outside this cycle.

release_evidence.note: Evidence covers Skill/package identity, coherent handoff autonomy, bounded native no-write behavior, deterministic CLI byte transfer, and unchanged source/disclosure boundaries.
